{{Quote|I&hellip;believe you. The Elders have said you wish to destroy the Star Forge and the terrible legacy of our ancestors. If you need help to do this, I will not stand in your way.|The guide to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
This '''Unidentified Elder Rakata''' was the [[Elders (Rakata)|Elder Tribe's]] guide during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. After [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] returned to [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] to destroy the [[Star Forge]], the [[Elder Council]] told this Rakata to perform a chant with several others, which allowed Revan to get access to the [[Temple of the Ancients]]. This Rakata was hopeful that Revan would destroy the Star Forge, and his hopes was fulfilled when Revan [[Battle of Rakata Prime|destroyed the Star Forge]], though it is unknown whether or not Revan aided this Rakata and the others in going back to [[Galactic community|galactic society]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
